### 4. Scored figures
(a) Wear forgiveness (amount doc baseline: "the excess wear charge billed for the turn-in, never more than the tier's wear forgiveness cap"; Tier 5 cap $0).
- Cap — return-to-brand wear cap doc: active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail contract dated within 90 days of turn-in and dpd 0 → tier's loyalty cap. 2026-07-02 → 2026-09-25 = 85 days, dpd 0 → Tier 5 loyalty cap $500; qualifying account number = that retail contract's `2093318476`.
- Additions to the cap: low-mileage (miles driven 31262−12 = 31250; allowance 12000×36/12 = 36000; short 4750 ≥ 3000) → $150; punctual-payment (exactly one late charge ever) → $75; retail tenure (first paid-in-full NV retail, 60 payments ≥ 48) → $200. Total limit = 500+150+75+200 = $925.
- Basis — advance inspection performed (2026-05-20, 49 days before maturity 2026-07-08) and final report counts 9 excess items (windshield 450, 4 tires 225, 2 missing keys 375, missing equipment 150, dent 175; one within-standard scratch excluded) > 5 → per item, $100 each → 900, under the charge 2425 and the limit 925 → **wear forgiveness $900.00**, qualifying_account_number `2093318476`.
(b) Hold payment (amount doc baseline: "hold rate of 50 percent times the invoiced end-of-term balance").
- Invoiced end-of-term balance = charges billed on the invoice day 2026-07-17 (2425 + 395 = 2820) less every waiver (the 900.00 wear forgiveness waiver) less deposit applied 525 less end-of-term payments 0 = **$1395.00**.
- Hold rate: delinquency stage 59 days (>45, ≤60) → 35 %; relationship relief (active NV retail dpd 0) −10 points; returned-payment relief (exactly one returned) −2 points → 23 %.
- Structure: total monthly payment 515.56; 1395.00 > 2×515.56 = 1031.12 → 515.56 + 23 % × (1395.00 − 515.56) = 515.56 + 202.2712 = 717.8312 → **hold payment $717.83**.
- Tiers ruled out: disposition loyalty waiver — loyalty condition met (retail signed 85 days after turn-in) but "Kestrel Lease Tier 5 … No" (allowances doc) and the lease has no loyalty waiver; no excess mileage (31250 < 36000) so nothing to bill.
- Fall-back (computation documents only, no factor): wear forgiveness min(2425, $0) = $0 → no waiver; hold payment 50 % × (2820 − 525) = **$1147.50** — definite and different from 717.83.
- Factor findability (record words → doc): "Kestrel New Vehicle Retail … active, contract_date 2026-09-25" → Return-to-Brand Wear Forgiveness Cap; "paid_in_full … payments_made_count 60" → Wear Allowance … Paid-Off Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Contract; lease_late_charge entry → Wear Allowance for a Punctual Payment Record; odometer vs allowance → Low-Mileage Addition; inspection_type advance_complimentary + item count → Wear Forgiveness Basis; invoice date / days since due → Hold Rates by Delinquency Stage; lease_payment_returned entry → Hold Rate Relief for a Clean Returned-Payment Record; active retail dpd 0 → Relationship Relief on … Hold Rates; total_monthly_payment → Structure of a … Hold Payment.
